name: streak
label: Streak
description: CRM built into Gmail. Manage pipelines, boxes, tasks, comments, contacts and organizations from your flows.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
Your personal Streak API key.

**How to get your API key:**
1. Open Gmail with the Streak Chrome extension installed.
2. Click the Streak icon in the right sidebar.
3. Click the **Settings** (gear) button, then go to **Integrations**.
4. In the **Streak API** section, click **Create New Key** and copy the key.

Your API key gives full access to your Streak account — keep it secret.

create_stage.label: Create Stage
create_stage.description: Add a new stage (column) to a pipeline.

pipelineKey.label: Pipeline
pipelineKey.description: The pipeline to use. Pipelines are your workflows in Streak (e.g. Sales CRM, Hiring, Project Tracker).

name.label: Stage Name
name.description: The name of the new stage (e.g. "Negotiating").

list_pipelines.label: List Pipelines
list_pipelines.description: List all pipelines the connected user can access.

list_boxes.label: List Boxes
list_boxes.description: List boxes in a pipeline, most recently updated first.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of boxes to return (1-200). Defaults to 50.

list_pipeline_fields.label: List Pipeline Fields
list_pipeline_fields.description: List the custom fields defined on a pipeline.
